merchant.description: UUID du marchand visé. Ignoré pour une clé API (toujours vous-même).

fee_charge_mode.description: ADD_ON : les frais s'ajoutent au montant débité au client. DEDUCTED : les frais sont déduits du montant net reversé au marchand. Défaut : configuration du marchand.

gotchas: With an API key, the calling server's IP must be whitelisted for the merchant, otherwise 403 ip_not_whitelisted.
No automatic currency conversion on payouts (unlike payins): the currency must match the beneficiary's country, otherwise 422 currency_country_mismatch.
Send an Idempotency-Key: without it a network retry creates a second disbursement. Reusing a key with a different body, or while the first call is still running, returns 409.
Amounts are decimal strings ("10000.00"), never floats.
Valid method codes per country and the expected recipient.msisdn format are listed on the docs' formats page (/api-reference/reference/formats).

A 400 validation error has a different shape from the business errors: `error` maps each invalid field to a list of messages ({"amount": ["Ce champ est obligatoire."]}) with no error.message or error.code, so read the field map, not just error.message (observed on the sandbox).
Payouts must be enabled for the merchant by SasPay: until then every call returns 403 payout_not_enabled, even with a whitelisted IP (observed on the sandbox).
The minimum payout is 200 XOF: below it, 400 with error.amount ["Le montant minimum est de 200 XOF."] (observed on the sandbox).

spans: `currency_country_mismatch` (aucune conversion automatique côté payout, contrairement au payin)
sans lui, un retry réseau crée un second décaissement
Montants : chaînes décimales (`"2500.00"`), jamais de flottants.
